description: This file defines the SiloConnectionListener class, which manages incoming network connections for a silo in Orleans runtime. It handles connection creation, configuration, and lifecycle participation within the Orleans silo system.

classes.name: SiloConnectionListener
classes.description: A sealed class that listens for and manages silo network connections, integrating with Orleans lifecycle system.

methods.name: SiloConnectionListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: Endpoint
methods.description: Property returning the listening endpoint for incoming connections.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates a new SiloConnection for an incoming connection context.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures the connection builder with silo-specific inbound options.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the listener to the silo lifecycle for initialization and shutdown.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles startup, binds to the endpoint, and begins accepting connections.
